rfcAnalysisReport.title: Stable Contract Core
rfcAnalysisReport.summary: RFC-0001 defines the stable contract core for the Enal Cognitive Platform. It establishes the foundational schemas (TaskIntentRequest, Event), BaseApp abstract contract, EventBus, FactoryRegistry, PipelineEngine, SkillsRegistry, ContractValidator, and VersionManager. This RFC serves as the anchor for all capability packs and defines the cognitive pipeline architecture with stages like parse, execute, validate, and output.
key_gaps: Some advanced pipeline features may not be fully implemented
VersionManager backward compatibility may need testing
